security_governance.hr01: Preserved: completion requires explicit adult attestation, no required evidence, and idempotency. This release implements no completion write capability.
security_governance.hr02: Preserved: every protected write requires a live/current managed Auth session. This release enables no Portal domain-write endpoint and makes no new global write-session guarantee.
security_governance.staff: Preserve accepted active staff capability + current managed session + verified TOTP-backed aal2 gate.
